Mid-October here: sunrise about 7:20 AM, sunset about 6:20 PM. Air sinks downhill overnight and early morning, switches to rising roughly 2 hours after sunrise as slopes warm (east faces first), then switches back to sinking about an hour before sunset. Drop wind speed to 0 to see thermals alone.
